orations|Adv1|or.en: Stir up Your might, we beseech You, O Lord, and come; that from the threatening dangers of our sins we may be rescued by Your protection, and saved by Your deliverance, who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

orations|Adv1|se.en: May these sacred rites, O Lord, cleanse us by their mighty power, and may they bring us closer to Him who is their author: through our Lord.

orations|Adv2|or.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of Your Only-begotten Son, that through His coming we may be worthy to serve You with purified minds: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Adv2|se.en: Be appeased, we beseech You, Lord, by our humble prayers and offerings; and where we have no merits to plead for us, help us with Your aid: through our Lord.

orations|Adv2|pc.en: Nourished with this spiritual food, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that through our participation in this mystery, You would teach us to despise earthly things and to love heavenly ones: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3|or.en: Hear our prayers, we beseech You, O Lord; and by the grace of Your visitation, enlighten the darkness of our minds: who live and reign,

orations|Adv3|se.en: May the sacrifice of our devotion, we beseech You, O Lord, be continually offered to You, that it may attain the end for which You instituted this sacred mystery, and wonderfully work in us Your salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3|pc.en: We implore Your mercy, O Lord, that these divine helps may prepare us, cleansed from our sins, for the feasts that are to come: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3w|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the solemn feast of our redemption which is now at hand may bring us help in this present life, and bestow on us the rewards of everlasting bliss: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3w|se.en: May our fasts be pleasing to You, O Lord, we pray; that their atonement may make us worthy of Your grace, and lead us to Your eternal promises: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3w|pc.en: Filled with Your saving gift, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that even as we are gladdened by its sweetness, so we may be renewed by its strength: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3f|or.en: Stir up Your might, we pray You, Lord, and come, that such as put trust in Your mercy may the more speedily be delivered from all adversity: who live and reign.

orations|Adv3f|se.en: Having received our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, Lord, to cleanse us by these heavenly mysteries and mercifully to hearken to us: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3f|pc.en: May the sacred reception of Your sacrament renew us, O Lord, and make us, now cleansed from the old leaven, to pass to the fellowship of Your saving mystery: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3s|or.en: O God, You see that we are suffering by our misdeeds; mercifully grant that we may be comforted by Your coming: who live and reign.

orations|Adv3s|se.en: Look favorably, we beseech You, O Lord, upon these sacrifices, that they may further our devotion and salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Adv3s|pc.en: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the most sacred rites which You have given to us for a safeguard of our new life, may bring us healing now and in the time to come: through our Lord.

orations|Adv4|or.en: Stir up Your power, we beseech You, O Lord, and come, and with great might succour us; that by the help of Your grace, what is hindered by our sins may be hastened by. Your merciful indulgence: who live and reign.

orations|Adv4|se.en: Look favorably, we beseech You, O Lord, upon these sacrifices, that they may further our devotion and salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Dec24|se.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that as we anticipate the adorable nativity of Your Son, so we may joyfully receive His eternal gifts: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Dec24|pc.en: Grant us, O Lord, we beseech You, to breathe again in the renewed birth of Your Only-begotten Son, whose heavenly mysteries are our food and drink: through the same Lord.

orations|Dec25_1|or.en: O God, You have illumined this most sacred night with the brightness of the true light; grant, we beseech You, that we who have known the mysteries of that light on earth, may enjoy also its happiness in heaven: who live and reign with You.

orations|Dec25_1|se.en: May the offering of this day's feast be pleasing to You, O Lord, we beseech You; that by Your grace we may, through this sacred intercourse, be found like unto Him in whom our nature is united with Yours: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Dec25_1|pc.en: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that we who rejoice to commemorate by these mysteries the birth of our Lord Jesus Christ, may, by a good life, deserve to attain fellowship with Him: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Dec25_2|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are bathed in the new light of Your incarnate Word, may show forth in our works what shines forth in our minds by faith: through the same Lord.

orations|Dec25_2|pc.en: May the new birth set forth in this sacrament ever renew us, O Lord, whose wonderful' birth did destroy the old man within us: through the same Lord.

orations|Dec25_3|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the new birth of Your Only-begotten Son in the flesh may set us free, whom an ancient bondage holds under the yoke of sin.

orations|Dec25_3|se.en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts we offer, by the new birth of Your Only-begotten Son; and cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

orations|Dec25_3|pc.en: Grant, we beseech You almighty God, that as the newborn Savior of the world: is the author of our divine regeneration, so also He Himself may be the giver of immortality: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Nat1|or.en: O almighty and eternal God, direct our actions according to Your good will; that in the name of Your beloved Son, we may deserve to abound in all good works: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Nat1|pc.en: By virtue of this mystery, O Lord, may our sins be cleansed and our just desires be fulfilled: through our Lord.

orations|Jan1|or.en: O God, You allow us to keep the octave day of our Savior's birth, grant, we beseech You, that we may be shielded by His eternal divinity, who redeemed us by taking unto Himself our humanity: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Jan1|se.en: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that through these gifts, whereby we celebrate the mystery of the hidden birth of Jesus Christ our Lord, we may reach the clear vision of a mind that is purified: through the same.

orations|Jan1|pc.en: Grant, we beseech You, O. Lord, that what we have received on this renewed feast of our Savior, may further our healing and redemption forever: through the same Lord.

orations|Nat2|or.en: O God, who ordained Your Only-begotten Son to be the Savior of mankind, and commanded that He be called Jesus, mercifully grant that, as we have sanctified His holy name on earth, we may be-gladdened by His face in heaven: through the same Lord.

orations|Nat2|se.en: With devout hearts we offer these victims, O. Father of mercies, in honor of the name of Your most beloved Son, our Lord; and we humbly pray that You would make our hearts overflow with the sweetness of His name, and rejoice in no one but You, the true God: through the same Lord.

orations|Jan5a|or.en: O almighty and eternal God, direct our actions according to Your good will; that in the name of Your beloved Son, we may deserve to abound in all good works: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Jan5a|pc.en: By virtue of this mystery, O Lord, may our sins be cleansed and our just desires be fulfilled: through our Lord.

orations|Epi|or.en: O God, who by the guidance of a star this day revealed Your Only-begotten Son to the Gentiles; mercifully grant that we who now know You by faith, may be led to contemplate the beauty of Your majesty: through the same Lord:

orations|Epi|se.en: Look with mercy, O Lord, we beseech You, on the offerings of Your Church wherein are now no who in these same gifts is revealed, is immolated and received, Jesus Christ Your Son our Lord: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Epi|pc.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that what we celebrate in a solemn rite, we may attain through the understanding of a purified mind: through our Lord.

orations|Epi1|se.en: We offer to You, O Lord, a victim of atonement, humbly entreating that through the intercession of the virgin mother of God and blessed Joseph, You would strongly establish our families in Your grace and

orations|Epi1|pc.en: Refreshed by Your heavenly sacrament, O Lord Jesus, help us always to follow the example of Your Holy Family, so that at the hour of our death Your glorious virgin mother and blessed Joseph may be near us, and we may be found worthy to be received by You into eternal dwellings: who live and reign.

orations|Epi2|or.en: O almighty and everlasting God, who governs all things both in heaven and on earth, mercifully hear the prayers of Your people and grant us Your peace in our days: through our Lord.

orations|Epi2|se.en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts we offer, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins: through our Lord.

orations|Epi3|or.en: Almighty and eternal God, graciously look upon our weakness and stretch forth the right hand of Your majesty to our protection: through our Lord.

orations|Epi3|se.en: May this victim, O Lord, we beseech You, cleanse us from our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration: of this sacrifice: through our Lord.

orations|Epi3|pc.en: O Lord, we beseech You, make us worthy to receive the fruits of these mysteries which, of Your bounty, we celebrate: through our Lord.

orations|Epi4|or.en: O God, who know that we are beset by perils such as our human frailty cannot withstand; grant us health of soul and body, that what we suffer for our sins we may overcome by Your assistance: through our Lord.

orations|Epi4|se.en: Grant, we pray, almighty God, that the gift of this sacrifice now offered to You, may ever defend us in our frailty and cleanse us from every ill: through our Lord.

orations|Epi4|pc.en: May Your gifts, O God, free us from earthly joys and ever strengthen us with heavenly nourishment: through our Lord.

orations|Epi5|or.en: Keep Your family, we beseech You, Lord, in Your unceasing love, that since it leans solely on the help of Your grace, it may ever be shielded by Your protection: through our Lord.

orations|Epi5|se.en: We bring these peace-offerings to You, O. Lord, that You in Your mercy may forgive our sinful deeds, and guide our wavering hearts: through our Lord.

orations|Epi5|pc.en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we may receive the fruit of that salvation which these holy mysteries have promised: through our Lord.

orations|Epi6|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that always bearing in mind reasonable things, we may follow out in word and deed, things pleasing to You: through our Lord.

orations|Epi6|se.en: We pray You, O Lord, that this offering may cleanse and renew us, guide and keep us: through our Lord.

orations|7a|or.en: Graciously hear, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers of Your people, that we, who are justly afflicted for our sins, may be freed by Your mercy for the glory of Your name: through our Lord.

orations|7a|se.en: Having received our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, Lord, to cleanse us by these heavenly mysteries and mercifully to hearken to us: through our Lord.

orations|7a|pc.en: Let Your faithful people, O God, be strengthened by Your gifts; that they may seek again what they have received, and by seeking may receive the same forever: through our Lord.

orations|6a|or.en: O God, You see that we do not trust in anything that we do of ourselves; mercifully grant that by the protection of the doctor of the Gentiles we may be defended against all adversities: through our Lord.

orations|6a|se.en: Secret. May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, ever quicken and defend us: through our Lord.

orations|6a|pc.en: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You refresh with Your sacraments may serve You worthily by leading holy lives: through our Lord.

orations|5a|or.en: Mercifully hear our prayers, O- Lord, and having loosed the bonds of our sins, keep us from all adversity: through our Lord.

orations|5a|se.en: May this victim, O Lord, we beseech You, cleanse us from our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration: of this sacrifice: through our Lord.

orations|5aw|pc.en: May the sacraments received by us, O Lord, be our support, that our fasts may be pleasing to You and a well-spring of healing to us: through our Lord.

orations|5aw|sp.en: Look mercifully, O Lord, upon all who bow themselves before Your majesty that such as have been refreshed by Your divine gift may evermore be nourished by Your heavenly aid: through our Lord.

orations|5ah|or.en: O God, You are moved to anger by sin, and to forgiveness by penance; mercifully regard the prayers of Your people who beseech You, and withhold the scourges of Your wrath; which we have merited because of our sins: through our Lord.

orations|5ah|se.en: Look favorably, we beseech You, O Lord, upon these our sacrifices, that they may further our = devotion and our salvation: through our Lord.

orations|5ah|pc.en: Now that we have received the blessing of this heavenly gift we: humbly pray You, almighty God, that it may be to us an assurance of sacramental grace and of salvation: through our Lord.

orations|5ah|sp.en: Spare, O Lord, spare Your people; that whereas they have been chastised by well-deserved punishments, they may find relief in Your tender compassion: through our Lord.

orations|5af|or.en: Further with gracious kindness, we beseech You, O Lord, the fasts we have' begun; that the observance we show forth in our bodies, we may carry out with sincerity in our souls: through our Lord.

orations|5af|se.en: Grant, we beseech You O- Lord, that the sacrifice of the Lenten observance which we offer, may make our minds pleasing to You and give us the power of a ready self-restraint: through our Lord.

orations|5af|pc.en: Pour forth upon us, O Lord, the spirit of Your charity, and, in Your love, make us to be of one mind whom You have fed with one heavenly bread: through our Lord.

orations|5af|sp.en: Protect Your people, O Lord, and in Your mercy cleanse them from all their sins; for no adversity shall harm them if no wickedness rule over them: through our Lord.

orations|5as|or.en: O Lord, hear our prayers, and grant that we may keep with dutiful service this solemn fast, so wisely ordered for the health of our body and soul: through our Lord.

orations|5as|se.en: Make ready our hearts, we beseech You, O Lord, by the solemn keeping of this fast; that we may ever offer up these worshipful sacrifices with sober minds: through our Lord.

orations|5as|pc.en: Fed by the gift of heavenly life, we beseech You, O Lord, that what is to us a mystery in this present life may become our help for eternity: through our Lord.

orations|5as|sp.en: Let Your faithful people, O God, be strengthened by Your gifts; that they may seek again what they have received, and by seeking may receive the same forever: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1|or.en: O God, You purify Your Church by the yearly observance of the Lenten fast. Grant that what Your children strive to obtain from You by abstinence, they may attain by good works: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1|se.en: We solemnly offer You, O Lord, this sacrifice at the beginning of Lent, humbly beseeching You, that as we observe abstinence, we may also refrain from sinful pleasures: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1|pc.en: May the sacred reception of Your sacrament renew us, O Lord, and make us, now cleansed from the old leaven, pass into the fellowship of Your saving mystery: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1m|or.en: Convert us, O God our Savior; and that this Lenten fast may be profitable to us, enlighten our minds by its heavenly teaching: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1m|se.en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts we offer You, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1m|pc.en: Filled with Your saving gift, O Lord, we humbly implore that even as we are gladdened by its sweetness, so we may be renewed by its strength: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1m|sp.en: Strike off, we beseech You, O Lord, our chains of sin; and mercifully shield us from the punishments we deserve by sinning: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1t|or.en: Look down, O Lord, on Your family and grant that while we are chastened by mortifying the flesh, our souls may burn with desire of You: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1t|se.en: Be appeased, we beseech You, O 'Lord, by the gifts we offer, and defend us from all dangers: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1t|pc.en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we may receive the fruit of that salvation which these holy mysteries have promised: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1t|sp.en: Grant, O Lord, that our prayers ascend to You, and repel from Your Church all manner of wickedness: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1w|or.en: Mercifully hear our prayers, O Lord, we beseech You, and stretch forth the right hand of Your majesty against all our foes: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1w|se.en: We bring these peace-offerings to You, O Lord, that You in Your mercy may forgive our sinful deeds, and guide our wavering hearts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1w|pc.en: May the reception of Your sacrament, O Lord, cleanse us from our hidden sins and free us from the snares of our foes: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1w|sp.en: We beseech You, O Lord, illumine our minds with Your own clear light; that we may be able to understand our duties and have the strength to fulfill them: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1h|or.en: Look down in mercy, O Lord, we beseech You, on the devotion of Your people; that as they mortify their bodies by abstinence, they may be refreshed in mind by the fruit of good deeds: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1h|pc.en: In the bounty of Your gifts, O Lord, enrich us with helps that are temporal, and renew us by those that are eternal: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1h|sp.en: Grant unto Christian people, we beseech You, O Lord, to understand what they profess and to love the heavenly gift they approach: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1f|or.en: Be gracious, O Lord, to Your people whom you make devoted to You, and mercifully cherish them with Your loving help: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1f|se.en: Receive, O Lord, we beseech You, the gifts of our service now offered to You; and, in Your mercy, hallow Your own gifts to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1f|pc.en: By virtue of this mystery, O Lord, may our sins be cleansed and our just desires be fulfilled: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1f|sp.en: Hear us, O God of mercy, and show unto our minds the light of Your grace: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1s|or.en: Look graciously upon Your people, we beseech You, O Lord, and in Your mercy turn aside from them the scourge of Your wrath: through our Lord.

orations|Quad1s|pc.en: By Your holy graces, almighty God, may our sins be blotted out, and everlasting blessings be brought to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2|or.en: O God, You see that we are powerless; protect us from bodily and spiritual dangers, so that we may not be harmed physically and our minds may be cleansed from evil thoughts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2|se.en: Look favorably, we beseech You, O Lord, upon these sacrifices, that they may further our devotion and our salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2|pc.en: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You refresh with Your sacraments may serve You worthily by leading holy lives: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2m|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that Your people who mortify their flesh by abstinence from food, may, by following after justice, fast from sin: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2m|pc.en: May this communion, O Lord, cleanse us from sin, and make us partakers of Your heavenly healing: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2m|sp.en: Be near to our cries, almighty God, and grant that those to whom You give hope of Your mercy may feel the effects of Your wonted clemency: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2t|or.en: Mercifully bring to perfection within us, O Lord, we beseech You, the virtue of this holy observance; that what we have by Your command undertaken, we may by Your assistance fulfil: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2t|se.en: Mercifully work Your sanctification within us, O Lord, by means of these mysteries; may they purify us from earthly vices, and lead us to heavenly gifts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2t|pc.en: That we may be worthy of Your sacred gifts, O Lord, make us, we beseech You, ever obedient to Your commands: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2t|sp.en: Be appeased, O Lord, with our prayers, and heal the ills of our souls, that we may be forgiven our sins and ever rejoice in Your blessing: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2w|or.en: Look down in mercy upon Your people, O Lord, we pray You; and grant that those whom You command to abstain from flesh meats, may likewise cease from evil deeds: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2w|se.en: Look down in mercy upon this victim which we offer to You, O Lord, and through these hallowed services set free the chains of our sins: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2w|pc.en: We pray You, O Lord, that the saving sacrament we have received, may further our growth in everlasting redemption: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2w|sp.en: O God, the restorer and lover of innocence, draw unto Yourself the hearts of Your servants; that enkindled with the fire of Your Spirit, they may be steadfast in faith and fruitful in good deeds: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2h|or.en: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, the assistance of Your grace: that while we duly set ourselves to fasting and prayer, we may be freed from every foe of soul and body: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2h|se.en: May our fasts, devoted to Your name, sanctify us for the offering of this sacrifice, O Lord, that what our rite outwardly professes, it may inwardly effect: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2h|pc.en: Let not Your grace forsake us, O Lord, we pray, but grant that it may render us devoted to Your holy service, and make us ever worthy of Your help: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2f|or.en: Almighty God, grant, we beseech You, that this holy fast may so cleanse us, that we may come to the approaching solemnity with pure minds: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2f|se.en: May these sacrifices, O God, abide in all our deeds, and be strengthened in all our works: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2f|pc.en: Grant to us who have received this pledge of eternal salvation, O Lord, we beseech You, that we may so walk as to attain it: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2f|sp.en: Bestow on Your people, we beseech You, O Lord, health of soul and body; that they may be fervent in good works and deserve to be shielded evermore by Your protection: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2s|or.en: Grant, O Lord, we pray, this saving fruit of our fast, that the chastisement we lay on our flesh may bring a new life to our souls: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2s|se.en: Look favorably on these sacrifices, O Lord, that we who pray to be delivered from our offences, may not be burdened by the offences of others: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2s|pc.en: May the: divine out-pouring of Your sacrament flood our inmost soul, O Lord, and make us more complete sharers in its power: through our Lord.

orations|Quad2s|sp.en: Keep Your family, we beseech You, O Lord, in Your unceasing love, that since it leans solely on the help of Your grace, it may ever be shielded by Your protection: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3|se.en: May this victim, we pray You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of this sacri-

orations|Quad3|pc.en: We beseech You, O Lord, in Your mercy, set free from all sins and dangers those whom' You make partakers of so great a mystery: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3m|or.en: Mercifully pour forth, we beseech You, O Lord, Your grace into our hearts, that as we deny ourselves food for the body, so we may keep our senses from hurtful excesses: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3m|se.en: O Lord, transform the homage we offer You into a saving sacrament: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3m|sp.en: May Your mercy assist us, O Lord, that from the threatening perils of our sins, we may be worthy to be delivered by You our protector, and saved by You, our deliverer: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3t|se.en: Through these hallowed rites, we beseech You, O Lord, may such fruit of our redemption come to us, that we may be withdrawn from all human excesses, and led to the gifts of salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3t|sp.en: By Your protection, O Lord, defend us, and always keep us from sinning: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3w|or.en: Grant to us, O Lord, we beseech You, that taught by wholesome fasting and abstaining from all harmful excesses, we may the more easily obtain Your mercies: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3w|se.en: Receive, O Lord, we beseech You, the prayers of Your people together with their offered sacrifices; and shield those from all dangers who celebrate Your mysteries: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3w|pc.en: May the heavenly bread with which we are nourished sanctify us, O Lord; may it free us from all error, and make us worthy of Your heavenly promises: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3f|or.en: O Lord, mercifully approve our fasts, we pray; that even as our bodies abstain from food, so we may fast from sin in our minds: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3f|se.en: Look down in mercy, we pray You, O Lord, on the gifts which we dedicate, that they may be pleasing to You and continue forever helpful to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3f|pc.en: May the reception of Your sacrament, O Lord, cleanse us from all sin, and bring us to Your heavenly kingdom: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3f|sp.en: O God almighty, in whose protection we confide, bestow on us, we beseech You, Your helping hand to conquer all our foes: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3s|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that Your people who mortify their flesh by abstinence from food may, by following after justice, fast from sin: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3s|se.en: Grant, we pray, almighty God, that the gift of this sacrifice now offered to You, may ever defend us in our frailty and cleanse us from every ill: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3s|pc.en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we may be counted among the members of Him of whose body and blood we have partaken: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Quad3s|sp.en: Stretch forth over Your faithful, O Lord, the right hand of Your heavenly help, that seeking You with all their heart they may deserve to obtain all they worthily seek: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are justly afflicted for our misdeeds may breathe again in Your consoling grace: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4|se.en: Look favorably, we beseech You, O Lord, upon these sacrifices, that they may further our devotion and our salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4|pc.en: Grant us, merciful God, to worship with sincere minds and receive with faithful hearts these sacred mysteries, by the fulness of which we are daily nourished: through our: Lord.

orations|Quad4m|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that keeping these holy fasts with devotion year by year, we may be pleasing to You in body and soul: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4m|se.en: May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, quicken and protect us forever: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4m|pc.en: We pray You, O Lord, that the Saving sacrament we have received, may further our growth in everlasting redemption: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4m|sp.en: In Your loving kindness, O Lord, we beseech You, hear our prayer; and having bestowed on us the will to pray, give us also the help of Your protection: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4t|se.en: May this victim, we pray You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of this sacri-

orations|Quad4t|pc.en: May the reception of Your sacrament, O Lord, cleanse us from all sin, and bring us to' Your heavenly kingdom: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4t|sp.en: Take pity, O Lord, on Your people, and graciously grant relief to those who labor under continual tribulations: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4w|or.en: O God, You grant to the righteous the reward of their merits and to sinners pardon through their fastings; have mercy on such as call upon You, that the acknowledgment of our guilt may procure the pardon of our sins: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4w|se.en: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that indeed do You bestow true health of body and soul: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4w|pc.en: May these sacraments we have received, O Lord, our God, fill us with spirtual food and uphold us with temporal aid: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4w|sp.en: Open, O Lord, the ears of Your mercy to the prayers of Your suppliants; and that You may grant the petitions of those who ask, make them seek only that which is pleasing to You: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4h|or.en: Almighty God, we beseech You, grant that we who are chastised by these fasts, may bring our passions under control and more easily attain the rewards of heaven: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4h|se.en: Cleanse us, O merciful God, that the prayers of Your Church which are pleasing to You, being laden with the offerings of our love, may become yet more pleasing through the cleansing of our hearts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4h|pc.en: Let not Your heavenly gifts, O Lord, turn to the judgment of those who receive them, since You have ordained them to the healing of Your faithful: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4h|sp.en: O God, the maker and ruler of all Your people, root out the sins by which they are assaulted, that they may be ever well-pleasing to You, and safe under Your protection: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4f|or.en: O God, through the miracle of Your sacraments You give new life to the world. Grant, we beseech You, that Your Church may profit by Your eternal commands and never want for aid in this life: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4f|se.en: May these proffered gifts cleanse us, O Lord, we beseech You, and make You ever more forgiving to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4f|sp.en: Mindful of our own weakness and trusting in Your strength, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may always rejoice in Your loving care: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4s|or.en: May the devotion of our heart be made more fruitful by Your grace, O Lord, we beseech You, for then only, will the fasts undertaken avail us, when they are pleasing to Your loving kindness: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4s|se.en: We beseech You, O Lord, be appeased by the acceptance of our peace-offerings, and in Your mercy, make our rebellious wills submit to You: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4s|pc.en: Let Your holy mysteries cleanse us, O Lord, we pray; and by their working, perfect: us in pleasing You: through our Lord.

orations|Quad4s|sp.en: O God, You choose to show pity rather than anger to those who hope in You. Grant that we may worthily weep for the evil we have done, and so deserve to find the grace of Your consolation: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5|or.en: We beseech You, almighty God, to look favorably upon this Your family, that it may be governed in body by You its benefactor, and preserved in soul by You its protector: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5|se.en: May these offerings, we beseech You, O Lord, loosen the bands of our wickedness and earn for us the gifts of Your mercy: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5|pc.en: Be near us, O Lord, our God, and defend with Your unfailing help those whom You have fed with Your mysteries: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5m|or.en: Sanctify our fasts, O Lord, we beseech You, and mercifully grant us the forgiveness of all our faults: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5m|se.en: Grant us, O Lord, our God, that this victim of salvation may cleanse us from all our sins and be our propitiation before Your majesty: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5m|pc.en: May our share in this saving sacrament, we beseech You, O Lord, yield us cleansing and healing: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5t|se.en: May the victims we bring to You to be offered, O Lord, be a pledge of conciliation in this world, that we may never despair of obtaining the promises of the world to come: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5t|pc.en: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may so continually follow after things divine as to deserve to draw near to Your heavenly promises: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5w|or.en: Enlighten the hearts of Your faithful through this hallowed fast, O God of mercy; and to whom You have granted the grace of devotion, in Your loving kindness bestow a ready hearing when they pray: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5w|se.en: Grant, O merciful God, that we may bring to You with sincere devotion this victim of propitiation and praise: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5w|pc.en: Now that we have received the blessing of this heavenly gift we: humbly pray You, almighty God, that it may be to us an assurance of sacramental grace and of salvation: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5w|sp.en: Be near to our cries, almighty God, and grant that those to whom You give hope of Your mercy may feel the effects of Your wonted clemency: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5h|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the dignity of human nature which has been wounded by self-indulgence, may be amended by zeal in this healthful fast: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5h|se.en: O Lord our God, who has ordained that those things which You have made to help us in our weakness shall also be offered to the honor of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that they may be an aid in our present life and a pledge of eternity: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5h|pc.en: May we accept with pure hearts, O Lord, what we have received with our lips, so that this temporal gift may become for us a source of ever- lasting health: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5h|sp.en: Be merciful to Your people, O Lord, we pray; that casting out what is displeasing to You, they may rather be filled with delight in Your commandments: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5f|or.en: We beseech You, O Lord Jesus Christ, let there intercede for us before Your mercy now and at the hour of our death, the blessed virgin Mary, Your mother, whose most holy soul the sword of grief did pierce in the hour of Your blessed passion; and whom a great joy enheartened in Your glorious resurrection: who live and reign.

orations|Quad5f|se.en: We offer to You, O Lord Jesus Christ, these prayers and sactifices, humbly beseeching You, that we, who in our supplications recall the piercing of the sweet soul of the blessed Mary, Your mother, may, by her multiplied and most loving petitions, with those of her companions at the foot of the cross, through the merits of Your death, have our reward with the saints: who live and reign.

orations|Quad5f|pc.en: May the sacrifice which we have received, O Lord, in memory of the soul-piercing of Your virgin mother, obtain for us from Your mercy, the fruit of every blessing: who live and reign.

orations|Quad5s|or.en: May the people, dedicated to You, grow in the desire of holy love, O Lord, we pray; so that schooled in these sacred mysteries, they may, as they are endowed with greater gifts, become more acceptable to Your majesty: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5s|se.en: We beseech You, O Lord, in Your mercy, set free from all sins and dangers those whom You make partakers of so great a mystery: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6|or.en: Almighty and everlasting God, who would have our Savior become man, and suffer on the cross, to give mankind an example of humility, mercifully grant that we may be instructed by His patience, and share in His resurrection: through the same Lord.

orations|Quad6|se.en: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that this gift, offered in the presence of Your majesty, may obtain for us the grace of devotion, and bring us to everlasting joys: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6|pc.en: By virtue of this mystery, O Lord, may our sins be cleansed and our just desires be fulfilled: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6m|or.en: We beseech You, almighty God, by the intercession of Your Only-begotten Son's passion, to grant refreshment to us who m the midst of many foes are faint from weakness: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|Quad6m|se.en: Cleansed by the power of Your strength, almighty God, may we be further purified by these sacrifices, and led thereby to the fount from which they well: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6m|pc.en: Let Your Holy mysteries, O Lord, inspire us with divine fervor, that we may rejoice both in their celebration and their effects: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6m|sp.en: Help us, O God our savior, and grant that we may celebrate with joy the memory of those benefits, by which You have been pleased to redeem us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6t|or.en: Almighty and everlasting God, grant that we may so celebrate the mysteries of our Lord's passion that we may deserve to obtain Your pardon: through the same Lord.

orations|Quad6t|pc.en: Through Your graces, almighty God, may our sins be blotted out, and everlasting blessings be brought to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6w|or.en: May Your mercy, O God, purify us from the corruption of the old man, and enable us to put on the new: through our Lord.

orations|Quad6w|se.en: Accept, O Lord, we pray, the gift offered to You, and mercifully bring it to pass, that what we celebrate in this mystery of the passion of Your Son, our Lord, we may attain by devoted affection: through the same Lord.

orations|Quad6w|pc.en: Grant to our understanding, almighty God, through the temporal death of Your Son which these sacred mysteries show forth, the confidence that You have already bestowed upon us life everlasting: through the same Lord.

orations|Quad6h|or.en: O God, from whom Judas received the punishment of his sin, and the thief the reward of his confession; grant us the effect of Your mercies that as our Lord Jesus Christ in His passion bestowed on each the different recompense of His merits, so having destroyed the old man in us, he may give us the grace of His resurrection: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|EmbFriSept|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that keeping these holy fasts with devotion year by year, we may be pleasing to You in body and soul: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3h|or.en: Grant, we beseech 'You, almighty God, that the holy fervor of our fasts may make us pure and pleasing to Your majesty: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3h|se.en: May our solemn fasts, we beseech You, O Lord, make this offering pleasing to You; and may it be the more acceptable to You as being offered up from sin-cleansed hearts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3h|pc.en: O Lord, may the august reception of this Your sacrament cleanse us by its mystic fruit, and protect us by its never-waning strength: through our Lord.

orations|Quad3h|sp.en: May this heavenly peace-offering multiply Your subject people, we beseech You, O Lord, and make them ever obedient to Your bidding: through our Lord.

orations|S0113|or.en: O God, whose Only-begotten Son has appeared in the substance of our flesh, grant, we beseech You, that by Him in whom outwardly we recognize our likeness, we may deserve to be inwardly created anew: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|S0113|se.en: We bring these offerings to You, O Lord, because of the manifestation of Your Son who was born for us; humbly beseeching You, that as He created them, so too He may Himself be their merciful receiver, Jesus Christ, our Lord: who lives and reigns with You.

orations|S0113|pc.en: Go before us always and in all places with Your heavenly light, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may discern with clear insight and receive with worthy affection, the mystery in which You would have us partake: through our Lord.

orations|S0506|se.en: Having received our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, Lord, to cleanse us by these heavenly mysteries and mercifully to hearken to us: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5fe|or.en: Mercifully pour Your grace into our hearts, we beseech You, O Lord, that we who curb our sins by willing mortification, may suffer in time rather than be condemned to punishment in eternity: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5fe|se.en: Grant us, O merciful God, that we may ever merit worthily to serve at Your altars, and to be saved by a constant sharing in their gifts: through our Lord.

orations|Quad5fe|pc.en: Let not the constant protection of the sacrifice we have received forsake us, O Lord; but may it ever drive from us all things that do us harm: through our Lord.

memoriae|1225|S. Anastasiæ Mart.|or.en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who celebrate the feast of blessed Anastasia, Your martyr, may feel the effects of her intercession with You: through our Lord.

memoriae|1225|S. Anastasiæ Mart.|se.en: Graciously receive our offerings, we beseech You, O Lord, and grant that the merits of blessed Anastasia pleading for us, may prove a help to our salvation: through our Lord.

memoriae|Adv3w|Feria IV Quatuor Temporum.en: Hasten, we pray You, come soon, and yield the power of Your help from on high; that they who trust in Your love may be helped by the consolation of Your coming: who live and reign.
May our fasts be pleasing to You, O Lord, we pray; that their atonement may make us worthy of Your grace, and lead us to Your eternal promises: through our Lord.
Filled with Your saving gift, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that even as we are gladdened by its sweetness, so we may be renewed by its strength: through our Lord.

addiv|cruce|or.en: O God, who would have Your Son suffer for us on the gibbet of the cross, to deliver us from the power of the enemy; grant to us Your servants, that we may obtain the grace of His Resurrection: through, etc.
